plugins.name: memex
plugins.description: Project memory, a code map, and telemetry — pointers and counts instead of retellings and hopes. Archives session transcripts before Claude Code deletes them, indexes them for full-text search, builds a trail of topics pointing at exact line ranges, generates a one-line-per-module map that says which file to open, links any file back to the conversations that changed it, and measures what navigation actually costs per edit.
